The user wants me to act as Evidence Critic and check each claim against the cited evidence. I need to flag only factual problems: overstatements, wrong numbers/dates/suppliers, causes not stated, products/NDCs not in evidence. Reasonable conclusions from cited facts are supported.

Let me examine each claim:

Claim 1: investigator: "Our package NDC 0409-1896-20 is on the FDA shortage list as "Unavailable" with FDA reason category "Other", manufacturer reports manufacturing delay, next delivery January 2027, estimated recovery March 2027." Cited: [shortage-0409-1896-20]

Evidence says: "FDA shortage list: Morphine Sulfate, Injection, 50 mg/1 mL (NDC 0409-1896-20) from Hospira, Inc., a Pfizer Company; availability: "Unavailable"; FDA reason category: "Other"; next delivery: January 2027; estimated recovery: March 2027; manufacturer reports: Manufacturing Delay; updated 10/08/2026"

This matches exactly. The claim says "Unavailable" with FDA reason category "Other", manufacturer reports manufacturing delay, next delivery January 2027, estimated recovery March 2027. Evidence says availability: "Unavailable"; FDA reason category: "Other"; next delivery: January 2027; estimated recovery: March 2027; manufacturer reports: Manufacturing Delay. Supported.

Claim 2: investigator: "Current stock of 55 units covers only 5.2 days at 10.6 units per day." Cited: [stock-15]

Evidence says: "morphine sulfate MORPHINE SULFATE 50 mg/mL (Hospira, Inc., NDC 0409-1896-20, NDA202515, critical drug): 55 units on hand, 10.6/day over 30 days, 5.2 days of cover"

Matches exactly. Supported.

Claim 3: investigator: "No ongoing recall for this NDC." Cited: [search-recall-15]

Evidence says: "Searched this run's FDA ongoing-recall snapshot for our package NDC 0409-1896-20 and product 0409-1896: no ongoing recall."

Matches. Supported.

Claim 4: substitution: "The FDA Orange Book lists no therapeutically equivalent product from another application for morphine sulfate MORPHINE SULFATE 50 mg/mL." Cited: [ob-NDA202515-006]

Evidence says: "Orange Book: MORPHINE SULFATE 50MG/ML (INJECTABLE;INJECTION) by HOSPIRA INC, application NDA202515, TE code none (our current product)"

TE code "none" means no therapeutically equivalent product from another application. The claim says "no therapeutically equivalent product from another application". That's exactly what TE code none indicates. Supported.

All claims appear supported. No factual problems. So unsupported list empty.
